digest.component_or_area: test fixture for authorship batched-map equivalence oracle
propositions: Batched-side Git walk recovers from transient rc128/rc0/EAGAIN but per-event oracle returns None from a single uncached call to resolve_event_commit, causing flaky equivalence failures.
Production resolve_event_commit is intentionally fail-closed (maps all errors to None) and must remain unchanged; test-oracle repair is fixture-only bounded retry without production modifications.
One-shot per-event oracle must match batched resolver behavior by retrying up to five identical calls and raising with fsck/count-objects diagnostics on persistent failure.

All batched/per-event exact position-to-SHA equivalence assertions in the fixture module must route through a shared bounded oracle helper to ensure transient tolerance without weakening exact value matching.
